name: two_circles
margin: signed gap m = ||c1-c2|| - r1 - r2 (px); m<=0 overlap/touch
note: Proximity gap between two disks. Near-neighbour of lines but the margin is a Euclidean proximity, not a segment-crossing margin.

name: lines
margin: signed segment-crossing margin (px); sign flips at the crossing event
note: Two drawn segments may be far apart in pixels yet cross; the decision variable is a crossing margin, not a proximity gap (contrast two_circles).

name: relative_length
margin: L_A - L_B (px); sign = which bar is longer
note: Rank two 1-D magnitudes. Near-neighbour of longest_bar (which is arity-3 selection) and bigger_area (2-D area).

name: point_in_polygon
margin: signed distance from dot centre to polygon boundary (px)
note: Membership in a drawn closed region. Contrast dot_side_of_line (open half-plane, drawn straight line).

name: angle_acuteness
margin: m = 90 - theta (deg) for two rays sharing a vertex
note: Interior angle at a shared vertex, decision near 90deg. Contrast orientation_sign (one bar vs canonical axis) and parallel_pair (two separate strokes, decision near 0deg).

name: counting_with_distractors
margin: min pairwise crowding gap (px); distance-to-count-change (verifiability, one-sided)
note: Open small-integer count of target disks among distractors. Contrast dot_parity (same apparatus, yes/no parity decision type).

name: aspect_ratio
margin: m = w - h (px) of one rectangle; sign = wider vs taller
note: Intra-object proportion of two orthogonal extents. Near-neighbour of fill_level (part-vs-whole proportion of one extent).

name: collinearity
margin: m = y_line(x_M) - y_M (px); offset of middle dot from the L-R line
note: Reference line is defined by two other dots (latent), not drawn. Contrast dot_side_of_line (drawn line) and spacing_order (horizontal spacing of a triple).

name: vertical_order
margin: m = y_b - y_a (px); + red dot higher on screen
note: Signed vertical offset of two dots (they never interact). Distinct from two_circles (proximity gap) and relative_length (magnitude comparison).

name: orientation_sign
margin: m = tilt from vertical (deg); + leans right
note: Orientation of ONE bar vs the canonical vertical. Distinct from angle_acuteness (angle between two rays at a vertex, near 90deg) and parallel_pair (two separate strokes, near 0deg).

name: nearest_square
margin: m = d(dot,B) - d(dot,A) (px); + dot nearer square A
note: Selection between two anchors by difference of distances. Distinct from two_circles (single proximity gap) and point_in_polygon (region-membership distance).

name: spacing_order
margin: m = x_L + x_R - 2 x_M (px); + middle dot nearer left dot
note: Difference of the two gaps flanking the middle dot in a row of three. Distinct from collinearity (vertical offset from a latent line) and relative_length (magnitude comparison).

name: bigger_area
margin: m = side^2 - pi r^2 (px^2); + square covers more area
note: 2-D area comparison across a square and a disk; mixed shapes break the linear-extent shortcut. Distinct from relative_length (1-D length) and aspect_ratio (one object's proportion).

name: steeper_line
margin: m = steepness_red - steepness_blue (deg); + red line steeper
note: Rank the orientations of two separate strokes. Distinct from angle_acuteness (angle between two rays at a vertex) and orientation_sign (one bar vs vertical).

name: fill_level
margin: m = (f - 0.5)*L (px); + bar more than half filled
note: Part-vs-whole proportion of one extent (fill vs total). Near-neighbour of aspect_ratio (proportion of two orthogonal extents); distinct decision variable and threshold decision type.

name: nested_containment
margin: m = min edge clearance of two nested squares (px); + inner fully inside
note: Region-vs-region containment (both visible, nothing hidden). Distinct from point_in_polygon (point vs region) and two_circles (proximity gap between disks).

name: dot_parity
margin: N % 2 via the dot count; crowding gap (px) governs verifiability
note: Parity readout of a dot count. Same connected-component apparatus as counting_with_distractors, distinct decision type (yes/no parity vs open count); disclosed as a decision-type variant.

name: longest_bar
margin: one-sided top-gap L_(1) - L_(2) (px); gold = argmax length colour
note: Three-way selection of the longest bar (A/B/C constrained answer). Distinct from relative_length (two-bar comparison, binary) by structure and decision type; the compositional selection the mission named.

name: dot_side_of_line
margin: m = signed perpendicular distance dot-centre -> drawn line (px); + above (smaller y)
note: Which side of a DRAWN line a dot is on (open half-plane, sign decision). Distinct from point_in_polygon (membership in a closed convex region) and collinearity (offset from a LATENT line, proximity-to-zero band decision).

name: count_compare
margin: min pairwise crowding gap (px); one-sided verifiability of the two counts. Gold = sign(N_red - N_blue)
note: Comparison of TWO counted colour sets (sign of the count difference). Shares the connected-component counting apparatus with counting_with_distractors (open count of ONE colour) and dot_parity (parity of ONE colour), but the joint decision compares two cardinalities, which neither single-set cell can express; disclosed as sharing the counting apparatus.

name: quadrant
margin: m = min(|dx|,|dy|) = distance to the nearer axis (px); one-sided verifiability. Gold = quadrant from (sign dy, sign dx)
note: 4-way selection of the quadrant of a DRAWN cross containing a dot (the widest constrained answer set in the bank). A compositional selection: the product of two coordinate signs. Distinct from dot_side_of_line (ONE drawn line, binary side yes/no) and vertical_order (dot-vs-dot single-axis offset yes/no) by structure (two axes) and decision type (4-way selection).

name: conjunction
margin: m = min(signed region distance, signed left-of-line distance) (px); + inside AND left
note: First COMPOSITIONAL cell (mission Phase 2): conjoins a region-membership clause (cf. point_in_polygon) with a half-plane clause (cf. dot_side_of_line). New because the JOINT decision is new — it is not either clause with an object renamed and cannot be answered from either clause alone. Margin is a composition law m=min(a,b): sign(min) is exactly the conjunction's truth value; |min| is the binding clause's distance to its flip.

name: relational_reference
margin: one-sided runner-up distance gap d(2)-d(1) (px); verifiability of the selection. Gold = colour of the dot nearest the anchor
note: Relational reference (mission Phase 2): a spatial relation (nearest the anchor) SELECTS a dot and the answer is its bound COLOUR attribute. Distinct from nearest_square (answer = the identity of an anchor A/B, not a property of a selected object); this binds relation->attribute, the compositional novelty.

name: inside_count
margin: one-sided min dot-to-boundary distance (px); verifiability of the count. Gold = number of dot centres inside the region
note: COMPOSITIONAL (mission Phase 2): a count composed with a containment filter (count o inside-region). Distinct from counting_with_distractors (unfiltered count of one colour, set_aggregation); here the count is over the subset satisfying a spatial predicate (set_vs_region). Oracle recomposes the count from an independent Kasa-hull circle fit + component-count.

name: arc_curvature
margin: m = signed sagitta = signed perpendicular offset of the arc apex from its chord (px); + up (arch)
note: First CURVATURE decision variable: which way a single arc bulges (up=arch vs down=valley), the sign of the sagitta. Ceiling-analysis-named ('arc curvature / convexity'). Uses the new shared Frame.arc primitive. Distinct from every straight-line/point world by the decision variable class (curvature, not distance/angle/area/count).

name: convexity
margin: m = min signed turn over the polygon vertices (deg); + = convex, - = concave (a reflex vertex)
note: Salvaged from glm/agent/foundry-4-glm. Global convexity of ONE polygon (a reflex vertex). Distinct from arc_curvature (local smooth curvature of an open arc) and angle_acuteness (one interior angle near 90deg). Gate 1 declares the vertex cyclic-rotation symmetry (proves gold is not keyed to which vertex is v0).

name: compactness
margin: m = spread_a - spread_b (px, mean pairwise distance per set); + = red set more spread out
note: Salvaged from glm/agent/foundry-4-glm. Within-set spatial dispersion compared across two colour classes. Shares two_set_aggregation with count_compare (integer cardinality difference) but the decision variable is a geometry of spread, not a count. Gate 1 permutes the dot list.

name: outlier_dot
margin: one-sided top-gap dispersion_(1) - dispersion_(2) (px); gold = argmax mean-distance-to-other-two colour
note: Salvaged from glm/agent/foundry-4-glm. 2-D dispersion selection (the most-isolated vertex of a triangle). Shares triple_selection/selection with longest_bar but the margin is a 2-D Euclidean outlier distance, not a 1-D length; unlike nearest_square the anchors are the other two dots themselves. Gate 1 permutes the dot list.

name: arc_compare
margin: m = c_red - c_blue, c = 1000/R (signed curvature difference of two drawn arcs); + = red more curved (tighter)
note: The structural repair of the hidden-threshold defect (SSOT §7.14): 'which of two DRAWN arcs is more curved' replaces 'is the arc strongly curved?' vs a code-only R0. Distinct from arc_curvature (single arc bulge-sign yes/no) and steeper_line (orientation/angle comparison of straight strokes) — the decision variable is curvature (1/R) compared across two curved strokes. Gate 1 permutes the arc list (colour-keyed gold).
